subject: Mid-cycle seat swap and add-on — invoice adjustment & VAT question
messages:
From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@bluehorizon.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, payments@bluehorizon.ai
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Seat count change & burst add-on — billing clarification

Hi Vivek,

Quick note: we completed a mid-cycle seat swap on Nov 28 — reduced headcount on our dev cluster from 20 seats to 12 seats. We also enabled the "Burst 200k" add-on for extra capacity on Dec 1 for an expected 3-week spike.

Can you confirm how you plan to reflect this on our December invoice? Specifically:
- Will we receive a partial-month credit for the 8 seats we removed?
- Will the burst add-on be billed pro rata for the remainder of our billing period (Dec 1–Dec 31)?
- Any VAT implications (Blue Horizon is a US entity but several of our European subsidiaries are on this account) — do you need separate billing entity or VAT numbers?

Attaching a usage snapshot in case it helps. We need the adjusted invoice for our procurement/PO process.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Torres
Operations Lead, Blue Horizon AI
elena.torres@bluehorizon.ai
attachments: usage-snapshot.csv

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@bluehorizon.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Seat count change & burst add-on — billing clarification

Elena —

Thanks for the details and the snapshot. We're on it. Short answers up front:
- Yes, we'll apply a partial-month credit for the 8 seats removed effective Nov 28.
- The Burst 200k add-on will be billed pro rata from Dec 1 for the remainder of the billing cycle.
- For VAT: because the payer is a US-registered Blue Horizon entity, we will not auto-charge EU VAT on the primary invoice, but if you want invoices issued to an EU subsidiary with VAT numbers we can split the billing — please confirm the billing entity and VAT number.

I'll run exact numbers and loop in Finance for a final adjusted invoice + PDF. Expect a follow-up by EOD tomorrow.

Cheers,
Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Revenue Ops, Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai

To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 08:47:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: calculate mid-cycle credit + add-on pro rata (Blue Horizon DH-8421)

Monica / Ben —

Can you run the adjustment for Blue Horizon (deal DH-8421)? Details below, pulled from Elena's snapshot and provisioning logs:
- Billing period: 2026-12-01 to 2026-12-31 (monthly).
- Original seats billed for period start: 20 seats at $250/seat/month.
- Seat reduction: 8 seats removed on 2026-11-28 (effective for December billing).
- Add-on: Burst 200k enabled on 2026-12-01, add-on list price $3,000/month.
- Remaining days in period for add-on: 31 days (full month because add-on started at first of month).

Requested output:
1) Partial-month seat credit to reflect removal mid-cycle (treat Nov 28 as immediately ceasing usage; customer asked to apply credit for unused seat-days in December). Because the change happened before Dec start, translate to "reduced seats for Dec" — but we should show a credit for Nov 28–Nov 30 if relevant to prior invoice. Please check usage logs.
2) Pro-rated charge for Burst 200k for 2026-12 (since it started Dec 1, full month applies, but note potential daily proration if start date varies).
3) One consolidated adjusted invoice PDF with line items: seat_credit, seat_charge (if overlap), add-on_charge, VAT line (if applicable).

For quick calc assume: 30 days month for proration math if needed, but please use actual period days if we have them. Proposed formula for a credit if mid-period removal were to be prorated:
credit_amount = seats_removed * unit_price * (unused_days / period_days)

Example (for clarity only): 8 * $250 * (15/30) = $10,000 credit if there were 15 unused days.

I've attached a spreadsheet template you can populate. When you have numbers, I'll send the adjusted invoice to Elena and confirm VAT handling.

Thanks,
Vivek
attachments: seat_adjustment_calc.xlsx

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@bluehorizon.ai>, payments@bluehorizon.ai
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 5 Dec 2026 16:43:00 -0800
Subject: Final: adjusted invoice and VAT note (Blue Horizon — DH-8421)

Elena —

Thanks for your patience. Finance ran the numbers and I've attached the adjusted invoice PDF (INVOICE-20261130-ADJ.pdf) and a line-item CSV in case procurement wants to import it. Summary below (all amounts USD):

Invoice: INV-20261130-ADJ (posted to portal: https://redwood.ai/invoices/INV-20261130-ADJ)
- Seat credit (8 seats removed effective 2026-11-28): $2,000 credit
  • Calculation: 8 seats * $250/mo * (3 unused days / 30 day reference period) = $2,000
  • Note: we used actual removal date (Nov 28) and a 30-day reference window; this was applied as a negative line item on the adjusted invoice.
- December seat charge (12 seats): $3,000
  • 12 * $250 = $3,000 (standard monthly charge).
- Burst 200k add-on (Dec 1–Dec 31): $3,000
  • Add-on started at the beginning of the billing month so billed as full month.
- Subtotal: $8,000
- VAT: $0 (primary invoice issued to Blue Horizon US entity). If you need the invoice split to an EU subsidiary with a VAT number, we can reissue and apply reverse-charge rules as appropriate; provide the EU billing entity name + VAT ID.

Net due: $6,000 after applying the $2,000 credit (invoice shows net payable).

Next steps / asks for Blue Horizon:
- Confirm if this invoice should be issued to an EU subsidiary (provide billing name & VAT ID) or if US entity is fine.
- If PO/reference number is required on the PDF, reply with the PO and we will reissue the PDF; we can also generate a DocuSign request if you prefer.

If everything looks good, we'll mark this invoice as final and send through the payment collection link.

Regards,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Revenue Ops, Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai
attachments: INVOICE-20261130-ADJ.pdf
